fluid-mosaic.alt: A slice through a plasma membrane: two layers of phospholipids with heads facing the watery outside and cytoplasm and tails in the middle. A transmembrane protein and a glycoprotein span the bilayer, a receptor protein holds a signaling molecule, a peripheral protein sits on the inner surface, cholesterol sits among the tails and a glycolipid carries a carbohydrate chain on the outer face.
